title: T0005 dataset search: open iEEG datasets with localisation, intervention linkage and post-intervention outcome
body:
Scope: open datasets with intracranial EEG + electrode localisation + delivered intervention (resected/ablated contacts or stimulation settings) + post-intervention outcome class. Sources screened (about 18): OpenNeuro ds004100, ds003029, ds003876, ds003498, ds003844, ds003399/ds003400 (not resolvable on S3); EpiVR GitHub; Kini 2019 full text (PMC6885672); IEEG.org (did not render); Wang 2025 full text (PMC12457187); Omni-iEEG project page, arXiv abstract and HF API; DANDI API (3 queries); web searches for RNS datasets. Only listings and small metadata files were fetched. No recordings were downloaded.

RANKING BY FIT TO PROTOCOL
1. OpenNeuro ds004100, HUP iEEG (A0033). Best fit. 58 subjects verified (ECoG 20 / SEEG 38). Electrode coordinates are present for 58/58. Contact-level 'resect' tags are in channels.tsv for 57/58 (missing for sub-HUP132). Therapy is RESECTION 29 / laser ABLATION 29. Original Engel subclass is given and the outcome split is 36 S / 22 F. Licence CC0, about 19.9 GB, EDF + BIDS. Caveats: (a) coordsystem.json says fsaverage in metres but the README says ICBM152 MNI, so R2 must resolve the frame; (b) no per-patient follow-up duration (Kini 2019 subset reports >=1 year); (c) no MRI/CT; (d) sub-HUP165 has no ictal run; (e) no stimulation cases.
2. Omni-iEEG on Hugging Face (A0040). 328 participants, ungated, about 159 GB. Channel-level resection flags and anatomical labels are present, but there are no coordinates. Outcome is binary only (Engel 1 vs 2+). The data licence is not stated. It largely re-packages ds004100, ds003029, ds003876 and ds003498. Its UCLA (50) and Detroit (135) subsets are new but have no coordinates.
3. OpenNeuro ds003498, Zurich HFO (A0038). 20 subjects with ILAE class and months of follow-up. Resection-zone contacts are in sourcedata xlsx. No coordinates, interictal sleep only. CC0, about 48 GB.
4. OpenNeuro ds003029, Fragility multicenter (A0035). 35 subjects in participants.tsv (37 directories) with Engel, ILAE and years of follow-up. No electrodes.tsv and no resected-contact tags; only surgery type and a free-text EZ region. CC0, about 11.1 GB. The Cleveland subset requires a DUA.
5. OpenNeuro ds003876, interictal multicenter (A0036). 39 directories vs 51 participant rows. No coordinates. Follow-up is heterogeneous and partly under 12 months. CC0, about 5.5 GB.
6. candidate-epivr, Kini 2019 (A0034). n=28 reported. The GitHub repo is code only (MIT). Data are on IEEG.org (access to_verify). It is the same HUP family as ds004100 and is effectively superseded by it.
7. Wang 2025 VBT (A0042). n=2. Raw SEEG is available on request only; the Code Ocean capsules contain one patient's preprocessed and simulated data. This is a modeling basis, not a validation cohort.
Negative: DANDI has no outcome-linked epilepsy sets. No open dataset with RNS/DBS/VNS stimulation settings plus outcome was found, so the stimulation arm has no verified validation data.

COHORT FAMILIES: fam-hup-penn (ds004100, Kini 2019/EpiVR, Omni 'hup'); fam-jhu-sarma-multicenter (ds003029, ds003876, Omni 'Multicenter'/'sourcesink'); fam-zurich-fedele2017 (ds003498, Omni 'zurich'); fam-omni-ucla-detroit; fam-aphm-marseille-vbt. Do not pool Omni-iEEG with its source datasets.

LEAKAGE NOTE: participants.tsv files carry per-patient outcome labels. Cards report only aggregates. R2 should seal labels in the vault before any modeling.
